nav.subtitle: Server settings
nav.overviewAbout: How the server looks and how it greets people.
nav.accessAbout: Who can join, and whether they apply first.
nav.ssoAbout: Members sign in through your organization's identity provider to join and to stay.
nav.joinFormAbout: Rules new members agree to before they talk, and what people answer when they apply.
nav.welcomeAbout: The banner, the welcome screen and the first steps new members take, previewed as you go.
nav.invitesAbout: Invite links that still work, and who made them.
nav.rolesAbout: Who can do what, ranked: colors, permissions and members for each role.
nav.channelsAbout: Order, categories, topics, slow mode, and who can see and use each.
nav.emojiAbout: The server's own emoji. Everyone here can use them as :name:.
nav.integrationsAbout: Agents, accounts programs drive, and webhooks, addresses other apps post messages to.
nav.sharedAbout: Channels shown in another server, or from one. Messages stay with the server the channel comes from.
nav.recordingsAbout: What recordings on the server keep: sound, or cameras and shared screens too.
nav.usageAbout: What the server holds, against its caps.
nav.limitsAbout: Caps for this server only, over the instance's defaults.
nav.applicationsAbout: People asking to join, with their answers.
nav.membersAbout: Roles, nicknames, time-outs, kicks and bans.
nav.automodAbout: Rules that catch messages as they're sent: blocked words, mention spam, links and a smart filter.
overview.name: Name
overview.iconHint: Square pictures work best. GIFs keep moving. Without one it's the server's initials.
overview.regionHint: Its messages, recordings and calls are kept there. An admin of this fuwa server can move it.
overview.joinMessagesHint: A hello in a channel whenever someone joins, so people can wave.
overview.defaultNotificationsHint: What members hear about until they pick for themselves.
overview.ownSettingHint: Each device decides, as it does everywhere else.
browse.hiddenHint: People join with an invite link.
access.whoCanJoinHint: Invite links work either way, for anyone allowed to make them.
access.inviteOnlyHint: Hidden from Browse. People join with an invite link.
access.anyoneHint: Listed in Browse for everyone on this fuwa server.
access.howInHint: Applications wait under Applications for anyone who can kick members. Set the questions under Rules & questions.
access.joinNowHint: Anyone who finds it or has an invite is in at once.
access.applyHint: People answer your questions and wait for someone to let them in.
access.dropped: Applications still waiting are dropped. Those people can join straight away instead.
access.linkedOnlyHint: Only people who sign in with waifu.dev can join or apply. Accounts made on this fuwa server can't. Members already here stay.
access.linkedUnavailable: This fuwa server doesn't offer waifu.dev sign-in, so nobody could join.
access.accountAgeHint: Accounts newer than this wait before they can join or apply, by invite or from Browse. It keeps throwaway accounts out during a raid.
access.gate.title: At the door
usage.allUsed: all {count} used: messages skip the smart filter until midnight UTC
usage.note: Limits are set by whoever runs this fuwa server. Self-hosted servers have none unless the operator adds them.
limits.intro: A cap that's off follows the instance default, which you can change in the instance settings.
danger.title: Delete {server}
danger.hint: Everyone loses access to its channels and messages. The server's operator keeps a copy of the file for a while, but you can't bring it back from here.
roles.intro: Higher roles outrank lower ones. Drag to rank them.
roles.pick: Pick a role to change it.
roles.lockedTitle: Ranked at or above your highest role
roles.locked: This role ranks at or above your highest role, so you can't change it.
roles.name: Role name
roles.colorHint: Members take the color of their highest role that has one.
roles.hoistHint: People with this role get their own group in the member list.
roles.mentionableHint: People who can mention everyone can always mention it.
roles.deleteHint: Everyone who has it loses it, and every channel forgets what it allowed.
roles.everyoneIntro: What every member can do, before their roles add more. Channels can still say otherwise.
roles.roleIntro: What people with this role can do, on top of @everyone. Channels can still say otherwise.
roles.notYoursHint: You can only give permissions you have
permission.administratorAbout: Every permission, in every channel, whatever a channel says. Still only over roles and people ranked below. Give it with care.
permission.manageServerAbout: Change the server's name, icon, description, AutoMod and welcome screen, and see its usage. AutoMod leaves them alone.
permission.manageRolesAbout: Create and edit roles ranked below their own and hand them out, with only the permissions they have.
permission.manageRolesChannel: Change who can do what in this channel.
permission.viewAuditLogAbout: Read the record of every change made in the server.
permission.changeNicknameAbout: Set their own nickname in this server.
permission.manageNicknamesAbout: Change the nicknames of people ranked below them.
permission.kickMembersAbout: Remove people ranked below them. They can join again.
permission.banMembersAbout: Remove people ranked below them for good, and lift bans.
permission.timeOutMembersAbout: Stop people ranked below them from talking for a while.
permission.manageChannelsAbout: Create, edit, move and delete channels. Also skips slow mode.
permission.manageChannelsChannel: Edit or delete this channel. Also skips its slow mode.
permission.viewChannelsAbout: See channels and read their messages, unless a channel says otherwise.
permission.viewChannelsChannel: See this channel and read its messages.
permission.sendMessagesAbout: Write in channels, and reply in threads.
permission.createThreadsAbout: Start a thread of replies under a message. Replying in a thread that's there needs Send messages.
permission.createThreadsChannel: Start a thread of replies under a message in this channel.
permission.createPollsAbout: Ask a question with answers people vote on. Anyone who can see the channel can vote.
permission.createPollsChannel: Ask a question in this channel with answers people vote on.
permission.attachFilesAbout: Upload files and pictures with their messages.
permission.mentionEveryoneAbout: Ping everyone with @everyone or @here, and any role, even ones that can't be mentioned.
permission.manageMessagesAbout: Delete other people's messages. Also skips slow mode.
permission.createInviteAbout: Make invite links that let people join, even when the server isn't in Browse.
permission.createInviteChannel: Make invite links that open this channel.
permission.manageEmojiAbout: Add, rename and delete the server's own emoji.
permission.speakAbout: Talk in voice channels. Without it they can join and listen.
permission.speakChannel: Talk in this voice channel. Without it they can join and listen.
permission.videoAbout: Turn their camera on and share their screen in voice channels.
permission.videoChannel: Turn their camera on and share their screen in this voice channel.
permission.recordAbout: Record voice channels on their device or on the server, and download and delete the server's recordings. People using fuwa see it and hear a beep; nothing can stop someone recording their speakers with other software.
permission.recordChannel: Record this voice channel on their device or on the server, and download and delete its recordings. People using fuwa see it and hear a beep; nothing can stop someone recording their speakers with other software.
permission.muteMembersAbout: Mute or deafen people ranked below them in voice channels, for everyone.
permission.muteMembersChannel: Mute or deafen people ranked below them in this voice channel.
permission.moveMembersAbout: Disconnect people ranked below them from voice channels.
permission.moveMembersChannel: Disconnect people ranked below them from this voice channel.
permission.manageWebhooksAbout: Make, change and delete webhooks, and see their addresses, which let other apps post in any channel.
channels.introArrange: Drag by the handle, into or out of categories, or focus it and use the arrow keys.
channels.introPick: Pick a channel to change who can see and use it.
channels.pick: Pick a channel to change it.
channels.topicHint: Shown at the top of the channel. Markdown works.
channels.slowmodeHint: How long members wait between messages. People who can manage messages or channels here don't wait.
channels.deleteCategoryHint: Its channels stay, outside any category.
channels.deleteChannelHint: Every message in it goes too, for everyone.
channels.deleteSystemHint: Every message in it goes too, for everyone. Join messages stop until you pick another channel for them.
channelPermissions.apart: Its own rules, apart from {category}. Its category's apply first.
channelPermissions.privateCategoryHint: Only the roles and people you pick see it and the channels that follow it.
channelPermissions.privateChannelHint: Only the roles and people you pick see it.
channelPermissions.nobodyYet: Nobody but the owner and administrators, for now.
channelPermissions.losingCategory: Saving this hides the category from you too. Add one of your roles to keep it.
channelPermissions.losingChannel: Saving this hides the channel from you too. Add one of your roles to keep it.
channelPermissions.advancedHint: Allow or deny each permission here for a role or a person. The rest follows their roles.
channelPermissions.notYours: You can only change permissions you have here
invites.everyone: Everyone's links are here. Revoke one and it stops letting people in right away.
invites.own: Only your own links show here.
invites.noneHint: Make one to let people in, even while the server stays out of Browse.
bans.noneHint: Everyone's welcome so far. Ban someone from the Members page or their profile card.
emoji.badType: Emoji are PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF pictures.
emoji.drop: Drop pictures here, or pick some
emoji.dropHint: Several at once is fine. Each is shrunk to 128 pixels; GIFs keep moving. The file name becomes the emoji's name, and you can change it.
emoji.noneHint: Add the first and it shows up when people type a colon.
emoji.full: This server has all the emoji it can hold. Delete one to make room.
emoji.badName: Emoji names are 2 to 32 letters, digits and underscores.
ownership.intro: They get everything you can do now, including deleting the server. You stay on as an admin, and only they can hand it back.
audit.emptyHint: Changes to settings, channels and members show up here.
audit.s.recordVideoOn: {actor} turned on recording cameras and screens
audit.s.linkedOnlyOff: {actor} let in accounts made on this instance too
audit.s.anyAge: {actor} let in accounts of any age
audit.s.minAge: {actor} let in accounts once they're {duration} old
audit.s.channelPermissions: {actor} changed who can do what in {channel}
audit.s.automodTakedownIn: {automod} took down a message from {target} in {channel}
audit.s.webhookToken: {actor} gave a webhook in {channel} a new address
audit.s.sharedUpdate: {actor} changed what the other server's people may do in {channel}
